about_the_game:
Everything Has a Beginning!

Once upon a time in a far, far away kingdom...

Wait a minute! This isn’t a fairy tale. There’s no magic to fix problems, no guaranteed happy endings. This is a game about reality—harsh, raw, and with no shortcuts.

Our dear Chico Chifrudo  has always been a rebellious soul, but this time, he really outdid himself.

After countless pranks in Hell—including turning the Almighty Trident into a mere barbecue skewer— 

The Lord of Darkness  finally lost his patience. Without thinking twice, he banished our mischievous little demon, condemning him to wander between worlds like an unemployed outcast of the underworld.

But… OOPS! Something went terribly wrong!

Amid this cosmic mess, three extremely dangerous souls  also managed to escape. Now, they are wreaking havoc on Earth—fires everywhere, cities in ruins, pure chaos that would make the Apocalypse look like a peaceful Sunday afternoon. And, of course, the Almighty One up there is not happy about this disaster.

So, He declared: Either the Lord of Darkness fixes this in a week, or Hell will be CANCELED forever!

Desperate and out of options, the Lord of Darkness has no choice but to rely on his only—and worst—hope: Chico Chifrudo.

Yes, the very troublemaker who caused all this mess must now clean it up!

Now, he must race against time, face absurd challenges, and hunt down these escaped souls before Earth turns into a literal Hell. But hold on! Nothing will be easy!

Will Chico Chifrudo save the day, or will he only make things worse? Well… there's only one way to find out—play the game!

🔥 GOOD LUCK! 🔥 (You’re gonna need it.)

This isometric platformer with cute graphics brings RPG elements, a death counter (for obvious reasons), and just the right amount of difficulty to make you question your life choices.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windos 10
  • Processor: i3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: 🔥 Chico Chifrudo was expelled from Hell after causing too much trouble. During his banishment, three dangerous souls escaped to Earth. Now, he must capture them before the world turns into a real hell! A platformer/isometric game with RPG elements, insane challenges, and plenty of humor! Good luck!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Spanish - Latin America, Portuguese - Brazil
